tasks.title: Email about the cooking challenge
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Family cooking challenge – your ideas
paragraphs: As you know, our class is helping to plan a family cooking challenge. We want to encourage families to cook healthy meals together. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should the challenge focus on cooking with fresh vegetables or on using less sugar? Which do you think is more important for healthy cooking?
Also, we need to choose one practical consequence to consider. For example, some families may find it hard to get fresh vegetables in winter. What do you think is a possible problem?
Finally, can you suggest one way to help families keep cooking healthily after the challenge ends?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which focus you prefer (fresh vegetables or less sugar) and explain why.
Describe one practical problem families might face and suggest a solution.
Suggest one way to encourage healthy cooking after the challenge.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the date of the challenge.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about healthy cooking
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our specialist magazine wants to hear about your experience with the family cooking challenge.
What is the most important thing families should learn about healthy cooking?
How can the challenge help families eat better in the long term?
Would you recommend the challenge to other families? Why?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: Story about the cooking challenge
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:

promptBlocks.label: Opening sentence
promptBlocks.text: When the programme coordinator announced that the cooking challenge would start next week, my family looked at each other nervously.

tasks.scenario: Family cooking challenge planning – email to teacher
tasks.purpose: Evaluate and justify priorities for the challenge
requiredContentPoints: preferred focus (fresh vegetables or less sugar) with reason
one way to encourage long-term healthy cooking

tasks.scenario: Article for specialist magazine about the cooking challenge
tasks.purpose: Assess effectiveness and recommend the challenge
requiredContentPoints: most important thing families should learn about healthy cooking
how the challenge helps in the long term

tasks.purpose: Analyse implications and propose action through narrative
requiredContentPoints: a justified recommendation (implied through story resolution)
